headline: SAFF stays at 4.32 on Female Daily (1,746 reviews) for a ninth flat day, but a September TikTok-viral list features HMNS and Mykonos, not SAFF, three days before Mykonos Soft Hour goes on sale.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily ratings unchanged vs yesterday and vs 1 Nov: SAFF 4.32 (1,746 reviews), HMNS 4.15, Mykonos 4.27, Alchemist 4.43; no product rating moved.
Mykonos x NCT Haechan 'Soft Hour' was revealed on Instagram 4 Nov, with a Jakarta fan event 6–8 Nov and sales from 11 Nov; Mykonos already leads Shopee perfume share (6.78% vs SAFF 3.53%).

SAFF prices are shown with deep markdowns: Zalora lists Maleali at Rp229k (normal Rp299k) and Morfosia at Rp249k (normal Rp349k), and a 6 Nov list puts ALENCINE/MECHLINE at Rp319k vs Rp409k at launch.
A 16 Sep Popbela list of TikTok-viral perfumes names HMNS Orgsm/Alpha and Mykonos California/Aphrodite but no SAFF scent; SAFF does appear in editor lists (Xocolatl in a May gourmand list).
Dark bottles hiding the fill level is a repeat complaint: now seen on Solaris (4.6, 100% recommend) as well as Ostara; S.O.T.B still holds a third of SAFF reviews at 4.1.

recommendations.text: Prepare a response to Mykonos Soft Hour for the 11 Nov sales window and 11.11: push top-rated scents (Xocolatl, Irai Leima, Troupe, Solaris) with review highlights, and seed TikTok and Instagram creators so SAFF shows up in 'viral' lists.
Align normal vs promo price messaging (ALENCINE/MECHLINE, Maleali, Morfosia) across website, marketplaces and Zalora so constant markdowns do not make 'normal' prices look inflated.
Set clear longevity expectations per scent (hours on skin vs fabric) and add wear tips, starting with S.O.T.B, S.O.F.R, Troupe and Cascavel, so the 'Extrait' label does not over-promise.
Packaging: add a fill-level window or lighter bottle option for dark bottles (Ostara, Solaris, Eulalie) and a travel size; ask QC to check leaks and outer-box damage in shipping.
Run a short quarterly survey (awareness, consideration, NPS), post a 'how to spot a fake' guide on SAFF channels, and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder to measure low-star drivers.
